monaco.title: Flag of the Principality of Monaco

colors.note: A heraldic colour of the House of Grimaldi, ruling dynasty since 1297.
The second heraldic colour of the Grimaldi family.

desc:
- Two equal horizontal bands of red over white, derived from the House of Grimaldi's dynastic colours
- Adopted on 4 April 1881 under Prince Charles III, replacing earlier banners that included the Grimaldi coat of arms
- The current design is virtually identical to Indonesia's flag, differing mainly in proportions (4:5 vs 2:3)
trivia:
- One of the world's oldest national flags still in use, dating from 1339 in earlier forms
- Monaco's flag is nearly identical to Indonesia's and is visually very close to Poland's inverted
- The Grimaldi family also uses a state banner with the full coat of arms on a field of the same colours
